title: National Partnership Emails — 2021
notes: The archive contains extensive overture advice, real-time GA turnout messages, nominations recommendations, RPR advice, and internal debate over Overtures 23 and 37.
Kessler states that the NP does not require uniform voting, while also circulating recommendations and asking participants to be present for specific votes.
The archive identifies Mike Khandjian as the principal drafter of the 2021 public letter later discussed in the NP and again distinguishes Khandjian's Fellowship gathering from the NP.

A July 2021 renewal message defines continued NP participation as denominational/presbytery work plus confidentiality. Drew Bennett explicitly replies that he wishes to continue as part of the National Partnership.

key_evidence_locations.description: Kessler commends public letter drafted by Mike Khandjian and other contributors
Initial overture advice and statement that NP is united in purpose but not a required voting bloc
Real-time turnout requests and beginning of Overture 23 discussion
David Cassidy tells NP Overture 37 is the principal measure to defeat and supports minority report
Kessler post-GA message says their side was outnumbered and urges presbytery action
Membership-continuation criteria and explicit Drew Bennett continuation statement
